title: Rochester Scottish Pipes & Drums to perform at West Point this weekend
text:
Rochester, N.Y. — A Rochester-area bagpipe and drum group is preparing for a high-profile performance this weekend after being selected to play at the U.S. Mili
Members of the Rochester Scottish Pipes & Drums are pictured as they rehearse for their upcoming performance at West Point, Wednesday, April 15, 2026. Rochester, N.Y. — A Rochester-area bagpipe and drum group is preparing for a high-profile performance this weekend after being selected to play at the U.
S. Military Academy at West Point.
